purpose: Prevent evaluator/gating confounds from invalidating the already-routed matched German Qwen3-ASR versus faster-whisper quality discriminator.
required_before_aggregate_quality_claim: For every pinned FLEURS row 0..31, persist both raw_transcription and transcription plus the exact raw hypothesis from every comparison arm.
Freeze one shared evaluator normalizer for all arms: Unicode NFKC, lowercase, replace punctuation/symbols with spaces, preserve German letters/diacritics/sharp-s, collapse whitespace and trim.
Persist the exact evaluator source/config and SHA-256; bind the hash to every aggregate WER/CER receipt.
Do not use a model-specific normalizer as hidden scoring authority. Any diagnostic alternative normalization must be labeled separately and must not replace the primary score silently.
If a speech row is rejected by VAD/turn admission, keep it in the speech WER/CER denominator with an empty hypothesis and separately count the gate false reject.
Do not put silence/noise/echo strata into speech WER/CER. Score those by false text activation, exact emitted text, gate decision and latency.
Report decoder-only latency separately from gated end-to-end latency and retain raw-decoder versus gated-pipeline quality metrics separately.
Hash the actual audio bytes delivered to every arm and verify arm-to-arm audio identity for the matched FLEURS comparator.
ranking_stability_falsifier: After raw hypotheses are persisted, re-score with the pinned primary evaluator and one explicitly named diagnostic alternative. If the material candidate ordering changes, mark the quality conclusion NORMALIZATION_SENSITIVE and preserve both results rather than promoting a winner.
next_exact_action: Continue the already-open T7-ASR-004 target run through the existing admitted Git VPS bridge on clay-direct-dev: pinned FLEURS de_de rows 0..31 through Qwen3-ASR direct, Qwen3-ASR with deterministic VAD/turn admission, and matched faster-whisper; run the separate pinned non-speech strata; persist exact transcripts, evaluator identity/hash, WER/CER, false activations, gate false rejects, latency and resources. Official Qwen vLLM streaming remains a distinct successor gate after resource-fit verification.
